statement: Between 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-30, Birmingham, Alabama police announce an arrest or criminal charge in the 2026-11-01 fatal shooting outside the Magic City Classic football game.
resolution: TRUE if Birmingham police or Jefferson County prosecutors announce, or two established news outlets report, an arrest or charge in this shooting dated between 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: No person is arrested or charged in this shooting between 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-30.

statement: The NYMEX WTI front-month crude settlement on 2026-12-15 is above 100.00 USD per barrel. Reference: 104.12 USD on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the FRED series DCOILWTICO value for 2026-12-15 is greater than 100.00. Reference: 104.12 on the packet date.
failure_condition: The WTI spot or settlement value for 2026-12-15 is at or below 100.00 USD per barrel.

statement: The US 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield closes at or above 5.00 percent on at least one trading day between 2026-11-02 and 2026-12-31. Reference: 4.93 percent on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if the FRED series DGS10 shows a value of 5.00 or higher on any date from 2026-11-02 through 2026-12-31. Reference: 4.93 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: Every DGS10 daily value from 2026-11-02 through 2026-12-31 is below 5.00 percent.

statement: Bitcoin closes below 70,000 USD on at least one day between 2026-11-02 and 2026-12-31. Reference: 77,934 USD on the packet date.
resolution: TRUE if any Coinbase BTC-USD daily close at 00:00 UTC, dated 2026-11-02 through 2026-12-31, is below 70,000. Reference: 77,934 USD on the packet date.
failure_condition: Every Coinbase BTC-USD daily close from 2026-11-02 through 2026-12-31 is at or above 70,000 USD.

statement: CISA adds a CVE affecting Canonical LXD or MicroCloud to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-11-02 and 2027-01-31.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog has an entry with vendor Canonical and product LXD or MicroCloud whose dateAdded value is between 2026-11-02 and 2027-01-31.
failure_condition: No Canonical LXD or MicroCloud vulnerability is added to the KEV catalog between 2026-11-02 and 2027-01-31.

statement: Between 2026-11-02 and 2027-03-31, the US Department of Justice files an indictment, criminal complaint, or civil forfeiture complaint tied to the Binance theft the FBI attributed to North Korea.
resolution: TRUE if a justice.gov press release or a federal court docket shows such a filing tied to the Binance theft, dated 2026-11-02 through 2027-03-31.
failure_condition: No DOJ indictment, criminal complaint, or forfeiture complaint tied to the Binance theft is filed between 2026-11-02 and 2027-03-31.

statement: In the scheduled 2026-11-03 US midterm elections, Democratic candidates win at least 218 of 435 House seats.
resolution: TRUE if Associated Press race calls published by 2026-12-15 give Democratic candidates 218 or more House seats.
failure_condition: Democratic candidates hold fewer than 218 AP-called House seats from the 2026-11-03 election as of 2026-12-15.

statement: Dan Sullivan is certified the winner of the 2026-11-03 Alaska US Senate election, with certification on or before 2026-12-15.
resolution: TRUE if the Alaska Division of Elections certified results, issued on or before 2026-12-15, show Dan Sullivan winning the 2026 US Senate race after ranked-choice tabulation.
failure_condition: Another candidate is certified the winner, or certification has not occurred by 2026-12-15.

statement: The US military conducts a strike on Iranian territory between 2026-11-02 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the US Department of Defense or White House confirms a US kinetic strike on targets inside Iran's internationally recognized territory occurring between 2026-11-02 and 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: No US military strike on Iranian territory occurs between 2026-11-02 and 2026-12-31.

statement: A magnitude 6.0 or greater earthquake occurs in the Vanuatu region between 2026-11-02 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the USGS earthquake catalog lists an event of magnitude 6.0 or greater with a place name containing Vanuatu and an origin time between 2026-11-02 and 2026-12-31 UTC.
failure_condition: No magnitude 6.0 or greater earthquake occurs in the Vanuatu region between 2026-11-02 and 2026-12-31 UTC.
